command_line:
set -eu
depdir="$PWD/.caper-pinned-deps"
python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input --no-cache-dir --target "$depdir" "caper==2.2.3" "miniwdl==0.7.0" "autouri==0.2.4" "pyhocon==0.3.53" "humanfriendly==9.1" "pyopenssl==19.1.0" "cryptography==3.4.8"
export PATH="$depdir/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONPATH="$depdir"
{
  echo python
  python3 --version
  echo java
  java -version
  echo caper
  "$depdir/bin/caper" --version
} > caper_probe.txt 2>&1
